A.	Hearing - Rezoning Closure
Co9-04-17, LEE PLAZA, L.C. - VALENCIA ROAD REZONING
Mark Road, L.L.C., represented by Presidio Engineering, L.L.C., requests closure for an approximate 95.4 acre rezoning (Parcel Codes 210-23-003C, 210-23-003D, 210-13-003E, 210-13-003F and 210-13-003G) from the GR-1 (Rural Residential) to the CR-4 (Mixed-Dwelling Type) zone on approximately 44.2 acres and from the GR-1 (Rural Residential) to the GR-1® (Rural Residential - Restricted) zone on approximately 51.2 acres, located approximately 600 feet north of W. Valencia Road and west of and adjacent to Mark Road. The subject site was rezoned in 2006, received time extensions in 2011, 2016 and 2021 and expired March 21, 2026. Staff recommends AGAINST CLOSURE. (District 5)

B.	Hearing - Rezoning Time Extension
	Co9-04-17, LEE PLAZA, L.C. - VALENCIA ROAD REZONING
      Mark Road, L.L.C., represented by Presidio Engineering, L.L.C., requests a five-year time extension. The approximate 95.4 acre rezoning (Parcel Codes 210-23-003C, 210-23-003D, 210-13-003E, 210-13-003F and 210-13-003G) from the GR-1 (Rural Residential) to the CR-4 (Mixed-Dwelling Type) zone on approximately 44.2 acres and from the GR-1 (Rural Residential) zone to the GR-1® (Rural Residential - Restricted) zone on approximately 51.2 acres expired on March 21, 2026. The property is located approximately 600 feet north of W. Valencia Road and west of and adjacent to Mark Road. Staff recommends APPROVAL OF A FIVE-YEAR TIME EXTENSION SUBJECT TO ORIGINAL AND MODIFIED STANDARD AND SPECIAL CONDITIONS. (District 5)
